Read the vendor page of each record. State the egress allowance or price. Keep fails-egress only when egress is capped or priced so that 1 TiB a day is not reachable.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- storage/helpjuice $.verdict: the cited page lists storage of the three paid plans (12/24/38 GB) and the pricing page shows no free plan, only a 14-day trial; fails-quota implies a free tier whose quota fails, which does not exist: trial-only or paid-only fits the evidence
- storage/helpjuice $.verdict: no free plan exists; the 38 GB is a paid plan allowance and the only free access is a 14-day trial (trial-only or paid-only, not fails-quota)
- storage/tencent-edgeone-free-plan-edgeone-makers-as-storage $.verdict: the page states no byte or request quota for the Free Plan: traffic and requests are unmetered with no excess charges; what fails is a content restriction (no video or large-file distribution), not a quota
